Tier Undying

Effect any creature that Steps, Strides, or otherwise moves away from you while adjacent automatically provokes The Answer; that reaction gains a +2 circumstance bonus to hit, and on a hit the creature's movement is disrupted — it wastes that action

Disengaging from you once engaged one-on-one costs everything.

cinderfall.incomplete: Any movement away from an adjacent caster auto-provokes The Answer with +2 circumstance, and a hit disrupts (wastes) that movement action. "Disrupts/wastes the triggering action" has no rule-element hook anywhere in the engine -- no selector retroactively cancels a different creature's already-declared action -- independent of the trigger-widening half.
